# CI Migration Cuts Build Times by 60 Percent

We migrated CI from Jenkins to GitHub Actions over six weeks. Average build time dropped from 18 minutes to 7, and the controller outages that hit us twice a month have stopped.

## Why Jenkins Had To Go

Six years of plugins left three problems.

## What Changed
Build time dropped to 7 minutes. Outages stopped because runners are managed infrastructure now rather than something we operate ourselves day to day.
